resources.string: Hotspot is on. Tap to open system hotspot controls.
Hotspot is off. Tap to open system hotspot controls.
Hotspot state unavailable. Tap to open system hotspot controls.
One large switch that opens your phone's built-in Mobile Hotspot controls.
Open Settings → Connections → Mobile Hotspot and Tethering → Mobile Hotspot.

Add the Hotspot Switch to your home screen. Tap the large switch to open Android or Samsung's own Mobile Hotspot screen, then use the switch there to turn your hotspot on or off. Return to your home screen and this widget will refresh its state.
